LanguageData.Raven_Wall.label: [Raven] Wall
LanguageData.Raven_Wall.description: A heavy wall forged from a composite of Raven Darkfeather Steel and iron. The interior structure is filled with energy-absorbing material to effectively resist explosions and blunt impacts, and its matte surface aesthetic is favored by the Raven race.
LanguageData.Raven_Terrain_Tile.label: [Raven] Floor Tile
LanguageData.Raven_Terrain_Tile.description: Floor tiles made of highly polished Raven alloy. Its surface is extremely smooth with natural stain resistance. It is very easy to clean and holds extremely high decorative value.
LanguageData.Raven_WallDiagonal.label: [Raven] Diagonal Wall
LanguageData.Raven_WallDiagonal.description: An elegant Raven-style diagonal wall for building more streamlined architectural structures. Just as sturdy as a standard Raven wall, it is made of solid Raven Darkfeather Steel.
LanguageData.Raven_Fence.label: [Raven] Fence
LanguageData.Raven_Fence.description: A fine fence polished from Raven Darkfeather Steel, used for penning animals or decorating courtyards. Sturdy in structure, it retains the Raven race's characteristic cold matte black.
LanguageData.Raven_GoldenLeafGreenbelt.label: [Raven] Golden Leaf Greenbelt
LanguageData.Raven_GoldenLeafGreenbelt.description: A fine greenbelt made from the Raven race's golden leaves.
LanguageData.Raven_DoorSingle.label: [Raven] Single Door
LanguageData.Raven_DoorSingle.description: A single-cell door with a top door frame. Its special slide-rail design gives it a striking three-dimensional look when opening and closing.
LanguageData.Raven_DoorDouble.label: [Raven] Double Door
LanguageData.Raven_DoorDouble.description: A spacious double-cell door with a sturdy top blast-proof door frame.
LanguageData.Raven_DoorDouble_Variant.label: [Raven] Double Door (Wide Frame Variant)
LanguageData.Raven_DoorDouble_Variant.description: A spacious double-cell door using a new reinforced blast-proof door frame variant, looking more solemn and imposing.
LanguageData.Raven_DoorMassive.label: [Raven] Massive Hangar Door
LanguageData.Raven_DoorMassive.description: An extremely massive three-cell door. Its top rail door frame can withstand extremely high-intensity physical impacts.
LanguageData.Raven_DoorMassive_Variant.label: [Raven] Massive Hangar Door (Wide Frame Variant)
LanguageData.Raven_DoorMassive_Variant.description: An extremely massive three-cell door using a new structurally reinforced hangar door frame, giving it a more dominating appearance.
LanguageData.Raven_FenceGate.label: [Raven] Fence Gate
LanguageData.Raven_FenceGate.description: A fine fence gate polished from Raven Darkfeather Steel. Animals cannot pass through, but colonists and handlers can easily open and close it.
LanguageData.Raven_DoorPlaque.label: [Raven] Door Plaque
LanguageData.Raven_DoorPlaque.description: A fine decorative plaque. It does not impede pawn movement.
LanguageData.Raven_Column.label: [Raven] Grand Column
LanguageData.Raven_Column.description: A high-strength load-bearing column cast from Raven Darkfeather Steel. Its unique internal load-bearing structure allows it to support a much larger roof area than ordinary columns (radius 14.9). It does not block line of sight or movement.
